target: Author-derived forest-soil CO2 mass flux on reserved future dates

input_units.tsmoisture: native soil-water-content percent; may be missing
input_units.moisture_change: percentage points of native soil water content; change from past mean
input_units.past_temperature: degree C; strictly earlier temperature summary

timing_contract: Known site/context, measurement date, native 5-cm soil temperature and soil moisture only; exclude author response-fit slopes, chamber conversions, confidence bounds and future flux. Expanded information budget: t05, tsmoisture, doy, moisture_change, site, context
calibration: See frozen development protocol and per-fold states; all learned calibration is training-partition-only. Context/site amplitudes are trained on earlier dates only. Lloyd–Taylor E0 is near 200 K with a documented optimizer-scaling limitation; it is not an identified globally optimized physiological coefficient.
independent_unit: complete reserved future temporal block at each calibrated site
reference_selection: First preregistered continuation candidate; other development-ranked candidates remain separate models, not new held-out selections.

scope_limits: Future dates at fifteen input-eligible calibrated sites, including a Uruguay site in the source. Not unseen-site transfer or causal treatment effects. Native negative flux measurements remain scored; missing 5-cm temperature limits coverage. Repeatedly exposed development out-of-fold cohort; not the original reserved cohort.
